scope: Four verified primary references for proposed ML methods; no trained model or experimental results claimed.

references.title: Searching for MobileNetV3
references.authors: Andrew Howard; Mark Sandler; Grace Chu; Liang-Chieh Chen; Bo Chen; Mingxing Tan; Weijun Wang; Yukun Zhu; Ruoming Pang; Vijay Vasudevan; Quoc V. Le; Hartwig Adam
references.supported_claim: MobileNetV3 provides Small and Large backbones; Section 6.3 evaluates both as SSDLite feature extractors at output strides 16 and 32. These support a concrete compact-detector comparison.
references.limitation: No published phone latency or COCO score is assigned to the rover. DOI omitted because it was not directly verified at an accessible primary DOI record.
references.verification: Primary publisher or proceedings page and accessible author full text checked; no Zephyron benchmark transferred.
references.venue: Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV)
references.author_order_note: Author order follows the CVF proceedings page and author manuscript, not reordered secondary indexes.

references.title: SSD: Single Shot MultiBox Detector
references.authors: Wei Liu; Dragomir Anguelov; Dumitru Erhan; Christian Szegedy; Scott Reed; Cheng-Yang Fu; Alexander C. Berg
references.source_locator: Sections 2.1 and 2.2; training objective and hard negative mining
references.supported_claim: SSD predicts default-box offsets and class scores at multiple feature-map resolutions. Its objective combines localization and confidence terms normalized by matched anchors, with a stated zero-match convention.
references.limitation: The manuscript uses SSD to specify a proposed training objective; no architecture has been trained on Zephyron data.
references.verification: Primary publisher or proceedings page and accessible author full text checked; no Zephyron benchmark transferred.

references.title: Random Forests
references.supported_claim: Random forests combine randomized tree predictors and extend to regression. This provides a candidate nonlinear comparison for independently referenced sensor calibration.
references.limitation: This source does not establish conductivity calibration or gas discrimination for the proposed rover. Such use is a new conditional experimental proposal.
references.verification: Primary publisher or proceedings page and accessible author full text checked; no Zephyron benchmark transferred.

references.title: On Calibration of Modern Neural Networks
references.authors: Chuan Guo; Geoff Pleiss; Yu Sun; Kilian Q. Weinberger
references.source_locator: Section 4; temperature scaling; Proceedings of the 34th International Conference on Machine Learning
references.supported_claim: Temperature scaling fits a scalar temperature on held-out data for class probabilities; classification scores are not automatically calibrated.
references.limitation: Classification calibration does not establish bounding-box correctness, object recall, or rover safety. Applying it to the proposed detector requires a declared label and sampling definition.
references.verification: Primary publisher or proceedings page and accessible author full text checked; no Zephyron benchmark transferred.
references.venue: Proceedings of the 34th International Conference on Machine Learning
